captureMethod: Chrome for Testing DevTools device toolbar: Responsive 1366×768, Desktop, DPR 1; menu → Capture screenshot (not Capture full size screenshot); original downloaded PNG copied unchanged.
pixelProcessing: None. Repository PNGs are byte-for-byte copies of native downloaded captures; no crops, resizing, composition, or image edits.
scope: Fixed 1366×768 viewport captures, not full-page captures. Content below the viewport continues by scrolling.

sampleConfiguration.kind: Synthetic illustrative configuration with 18 public-site shortcuts and four Chinese categories
sampleConfiguration.icons: Original locally generated PNG monograms; no external icon downloads
sampleConfiguration.cards: Manually entered sample weather, topics, and movie content; not live feeds
sampleConfiguration.search: Normal saved Google provider, never submitted during capture
